discount_or_rate: Subsidized Rates for KSUM UID Startup
description: Startups with a valid KSUM UID can avail access to instrumentation and laboratory facilities at KFRI at subsidized rates, with a discount of up to 40%, subject to applicable terms and conditions. Analytical charges apply, and applications can be submitted using the prescribed application form. KSCSTE-KFRI may levy separate charges for specialized services and the use of advanced or sophisticated instrumentation.
